item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will continue to bring cold and dry weather to the coastal areas of southern China in the next few days. It will be mainly fine over the region early next week. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise slightly midweek next week.

Date/Month: 22/12 (Friday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Cold, mainly cloudy and dry.
Temp range: 8 - 12 C
R.H. range: 40 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 23/12 (Saturday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Dry with bright periods. Cold in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 9 - 13 C
R.H. range: 40 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 24/12 (Sunday)
